description: Source code for ADXL367 sensor trigger handling in Zephyr RTOS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and trigger configuration.

methods.name: adxl367_thread_cb
methods.description: Handles ADXL367 interrupt status, calls appropriate handlers, and reconfigures GPIO interrupt.

methods.name: adxl367_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback that disables interrupt and signals thread or work queue.

methods.name: adxl367_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling triggers in own thread mode.

methods.name: adxl367_work_cb
methods.description: Work queue callback for handling triggers in global thread mode.

methods.name: adxl367_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures sensor triggers and interrupt masks.

methods.name: adxl367_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for ADXL367 sensor.
